The [direct PHP-Wasm Fin checks](../evidence/php-wasm-fin-direct-20261010/index.json) separately execute seven scalar exports with 2,028 checks and twelve direct/nested Array/List/Option exports with 14,089 checks per execution. Both ordinary-source and independently reviewed packages run in all twelve Node/Chromium configurations, totaling 48 executions. These runs use Node 22.23.2, Chromium 152.0.7977.75 and PHP 8.4.1 on wasm32. They include empty Array/List (Fin 0), absent/present Option (Fin 0), wide bounds, invalid element positions, input immutability and recovery. Six fresh-Lean cases reject altered or omitted bounds before package output. Dispatch remains unmeasured.

The [hosted native product and field matrix](../evidence/fin-native-hosted-20261010/receipt.json) supplies the table's native and CPAN pair, Except, Array-of-products and nominal-field acceptance. Its 78 original reports cover all eleven native/Perl host profiles, both source routes, Python 3.11/3.12 and four Perl ABIs. The native runs do not establish PHP-Wasm acceptance.
